CustomField.description: This field will help determine which products should be targeted by marketing.
CustomField.formula:
IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Remove From List"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Inactive"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Fraud"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Duplicate"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Other"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Private Party"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Vendor - EPP"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Vendor - FPC"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Lender - Lease"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Lender - MCA"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Lender - Alt"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Lender - Merchant"), Do_Not_Solicit__c = True, Out_of_Business__c = True, AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Do Not Solicit"), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Do Not Solicit")))), "Do Not Solicit",
IF( OR(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Vendor - VAP"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Vendor - Lease Eq")), "Vendor",
IF( AND( OR(OR(Min_FICO_Score__c = Null, Min_FICO_Score__c = 0), AND(Lease_Opportunities_Funded__c >= 1, Min_FICO_Score__c >= 550), AND(Lease_Opportunities_Funded__c = 0, Min_FICO_Score__c >= 575)), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Interested")), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Interested"))), "ALL",
IF( OR( AND( OR(OR(Min_FICO_Score__c = Null, Min_FICO_Score__c = 0), AND( Lease_Opportunities_Funded__c >= 1, Min_FICO_Score__c >= 550), AND(Lease_Opportunities_Funded__c = 0, Min_FICO_Score__c >= 575)), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Not Qualified"), ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Not Interested")), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Interested"))), AND( OR(OR(Min_FICO_Score__c = Null, Min_FICO_Score__c = 0), AND( Lease_Opportunities_Funded__c >= 1, Min_FICO_Score__c < 550), AND(Lease_Opportunities_Funded__c = 0, Min_FICO_Score__c < 575)), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Interested")))), "Working Capital",
IF( AND( OR(OR(Min_FICO_Score__c = Null, Min_FICO_Score__c = 0), AND(Lease_Opportunities_Funded__c >= 1, Min_FICO_Score__c >= 550), AND(Lease_Opportunities_Funded__c = 0, Min_FICO_Score__c >= 575)), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Qualified"), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Interested")), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Interested"), ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, ""))), "Lease",
IF( OR( OR(AND( Lease_Opportunities_Funded__c >= 1, Min_FICO_Score__c < 550), AND(Lease_Opportunities_Funded__c = 0, Min_FICO_Score__c < 575)), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Qualified"), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Interested")), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Interested"), ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "")), AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Not Interested"), ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Not Qualified")), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Interested"), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Qualified")))), "Not Qualified - All","Sucka"))))))
